svg.text: gold dry grass, flat-topped acacias, red earth showing, termite towers
A. At fight distance, noon: the ground profile, the cover silhouettes, the far land as a value ladder. The two grey figures are 75 units tall (a fighter): scale only, no character art.
Palette at noon (the world-light tint per sky key multiplies it; lit, mid and shade are the three faces of one surface; the far ladder is each ridge hazed toward the horizon)

Readability (docs/art/dynamic-sky.md section 6): worst aura against any tone 26.7 CIEDE2000 (rule: 20 or more), worst Protagonist or rival body against ground, rock or vegetation 21.5 (rule: 15 or more), over every sky key with the world-light tint.
B. What the fight leaves: scorched (a beam along the ground), cratered (an impact), burned (fire on what grows)
a black scorch band through the dry grass with a glowing-free ember edge
(grey, not lit), the red earth showing in the middle
a round bowl of red-orange earth, the dry grass flattened outward in a
a grass fire: the gold turned to black and ash-grey over a wide patch,
acacia crowns gone, trunks black, termite towers dusted grey
C. Destruction in savanna: the impact at three moments (burst, peak, settle). Red-ochre dust, tall and wide, with tumbling grass clumps; it hangs a little longer than sand because the dust is fine.
D. Where it meets its neighbours (hard steps in colour, never a fade; the cover mixes over about a third of the width)
Dry scrub and driftwood on the sand; the sand stains toward red earth.
The green dries to gold in steps; acacias appear among the grass; the first red

Thorn scrub thins; red earth takes over from gold grass; acacias become single
A floodplain: flat, gold grass with pools and reeds, a few acacias on the higher
